title: [R4] JMAP response unpacking uses 2-tuple instead of 3-tuple
description: Line 566 in web/app.js: responses are JMAP 3-tuples [methodName, result, callId] but unpacked as 2-tuples. This works (callId ignored) but masks the protocol structure and will confuse maintenance. Fix: use [methodName, result, callId] pattern consistently.
